accessSummary: JR Keiyo Line, Kaihimmakuhari Station: about 5 min walk / JR Keiyo Line, Makuharitoyosuna Station: about 20 min walk / JR Sobu Line and Keisei Line, Makuharihongo Station: about 17 min by bus bound for "Makuhari Messe Central"
hours: For the International Exhibition Hall, one day is 0:00-24:00 (a half day is 0:00-12:00 or 12:00-24:00). ops.prevDaySetup: For the International Exhibition Hall, one day is 0:00-24:00 and a half day is 0:00-12:00 or 12:00-24:00. The usage fee per exhibition hall per day is 2,298,470 yen for Exhibition Halls 1-8, 3,065,330 yen for Exhibition Hall 9 and 1,532,660 yen for Exhibition Halls 10-11 (tax included, for use from April 1, 2026). Discounts (for example, an amount equivalent to 90% of the usage fee) are available for simultaneous use of 8 or more of Exhibition Halls 1-11 (7 or more if Hall 9 is included), for use in January or August, and for use of 30 consecutive days or more. For the International Conference Hall, when the Convention Hall or the International Conference Room is used for setup and removal, the fee is 80% of the usage fee (not applied to overtime charges). For Makuhari Event Hall, separate setup and removal fees are set, for 12 hours per session: 1,210,000 yen for ceremonies, assemblies, exhibitions and the like, 1,650,000 yen for commercial performances, and 660,000 yen for amateur sports and public events (tax included, for use from January 1, 2027; 990,000 yen, 1,320,000 yen and 495,000 yen for use through December 2026). For use before 8:00 or after 22:00, attendant personnel costs are charged separately. (Source: International Exhibition Hall Price List from April 1, 2026 use; International Conference Hall Price List, January 2027 edition; Makuhari Event Hall Price List, January 2027 edition and for use through December 2026)
ops.loadingHours: Exhibition halls are rented by the day (0:00-24:00) or half day. The load-in and load-out entrances are: for Exhibition Halls 1-8, north entrances W5.2 m x H4 m x 2 and south entrances W8.3 m x H5.6 m (on-site gate width 9 m); for Exhibition Halls 9-11, W10 m x H4.6 m for each hall (identical on the east and west sides, on-site gate width 10 m). Trucks can drive directly in through multiple load-in and load-out entrances of each hall. Makuhari Event Hall has 2 load-in and load-out entrances (4.5 m wide x 3.8 m high). The International Conference Hall has a freight elevator. Meeting room use at the International Conference Hall is in time slots within 9:00-21:00 (9-12, 13-17, 18-21, 9-17, 13-21 and 9-21), with overtime in 1-hour units. The basic usage fee for Makuhari Event Hall is for 12 consecutive hours as one session, and attendant personnel costs are charged separately before 8:00 and after 22:00. Procedures in advance: for the International Exhibition Hall, fill in the usage plan form by 1 month before the start of use, attach the venue layout drawing, the drawings of various construction work, the application for use of heating and cooling equipment and the application for use of electrical and other equipment, and hold a meeting with the Business Division 2 (the security plan is also a matter for the meeting). For the International Conference Hall and Makuhari Event Hall, meetings with the Business Division 1 begin about 1 month before the start of use, and for the Event Hall the load-in and load-out and setup and removal plans are also matters for the meeting. The user files the event notification with the police station, the event notification and fire prevention manager appointment notification with the fire department, and the food business permit application with the public health center. (Source: Facility Guide Pamphlet, September 2024; Usage Procedure; International Exhibition Hall Price List, April 2026; International Conference Hall Price List, January 2027 edition; Makuhari Event Hall Price List, January 2027 edition)
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles that can enter through the on-site gates are limited to a gross weight (vehicle weight + load) of 30 t or less for Exhibition Halls 1-8, 45 t or less for Exhibition Halls 9-11, and 30 t or less for the load-in and load-out entrances of Makuhari Event Hall. The terms of use of the International Exhibition Hall, the International Conference Hall and Makuhari Event Hall require the user to prepare a security manual describing the plan for organizing and guiding load-in and load-out vehicles and visitor vehicles, the plan for organizing and guiding visitors, and emergency response, so that vehicles and visitors are guided safely and smoothly. Vehicles that need to be left on site can be parked in the Makuhari Messe parking lot, and the fee is based on the number of days of use (example: for a standard-size car entering at 20:00 on April 1 and leaving at 8:00 on April 2, 1,000 yen x 2 days). Overnight stays in the parking lot are not allowed. (Source: Facility Guide Pamphlet, September 2024; International Conference Hall and Makuhari Event Hall Terms of Use, applied from January 1, 2027; International Exhibition Hall Terms of Use, applied from October 1, 2023; official website Q&A)
ops.parking: The Makuhari Messe parking lot (3-1 Toyosuna, Mihama-ku, Chiba City) has 5,000 spaces for standard-size cars, 120 for large vehicles and 50 for motorcycles (plus 51 spaces for wheelchair users), and is open 8:00-23:00 (entry until 21:00). The fee is 1,000 yen per day per entry for standard and semi-medium-sized vehicles, 4,100 yen for large and medium-sized vehicles and 200 yen for motorcycles, and reservations are not accepted. Cashless payment is accepted. There is a bus drop-off and pick-up area, and it is free for up to 15 minutes for drop-off and pick-up only. The nearby Makuhari New City Prefectural Underground Parking No. 2 has 459 spaces and is open 24 hours, with a regular rate of 100 yen per 20 minutes and a maximum of 1,000 yen within 24 hours after parking (the official website shows Prefectural Underground Parking No. 1 as closed). (Source: Official website, Access and Q&A, retrieved November 2026)
ops.waitingRooms: In the International Exhibition Hall, each of Exhibition Halls 1-8 comes with an organizer's room (116 m²), a multipurpose room (181 m²), a business meeting area (116 m²) and a kitchenette, and the conference rooms are 3 rooms of 116 m² and 5 rooms of 82 m² (usage fee charged separately). Exhibition Hall 9 has an organizer's room (68 m²), 2 multipurpose rooms (65 m² and 81 m²), 3 business meeting rooms (83 m², 124 m² and 86 m²) and a conference room (130 m²); Hall 10 has an organizer's room (87 m²), a multipurpose room (87 m²), a business meeting room (85 m²) and a conference room (130 m²); Hall 11 has an organizer's room (92 m²), a multipurpose room (92 m²), a business meeting room (85 m²) and a conference room (130 m²). Exhibition Halls 9-11 also have a Special Meeting Room (2F, 176 m², with 1 waiting room). The International Conference Hall has 2 VIP reception rooms (Room 1: 65 m², seats 8; Room 2: 30 m², seats 6) and rooms 213-216 on the 2nd floor (16 m² each, hollow square for 8 to 12). Makuhari Event Hall has 5 staff rooms (45 m², 40 m², 95 m², 125 m² and 95 m²), a Rehearsal Room of 320 m², a VIP Reception Room of 62 m², 2 shower rooms and 1 first-aid room. Included in the basic usage fee: Staff Rooms 1-5 and the Rehearsal Room for use from January 2027, and Staff Room 1 and the Rehearsal Room for use through December 2026. (Source: Official website, facility pages for the International Exhibition Hall, International Conference Hall and Makuhari Event Hall; each price list)
ops.catering: All food and drink at the International Conference Hall is provided by Makuhari Messe, and food and drink arranged by the user cannot be brought in. The party plan starts at 4,000 yen (excluding tax) for food for 20 or more people; the banquet is up to 2 hours, in principle standing or buffet style, to be consulted on by 1 month before and ordered by 14 days before (excluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays). The Hana Plan (with all-you-can-drink) is 7,700 yen including tax and the En Plan (with all-you-can-drink) is 6,600 yen including tax (each per person, room fee included). Bento boxes are 1,000 to 1,600 yen (excluding tax) and Shokado Gozen are 2,000 to 4,000 yen (excluding tax). The International Exhibition Hall does not have a designated vendor system, and the user arranges the vendors involved in setting up and running the venue (electricity, water, security, cleaning and so on). The user files the notifications and permit applications required for the event, such as the food business permit application to the public health center. (Source: International Conference Hall Party Plan, applied from February 1, 2026; Catering Menu PDF [applied from October 1, 2025]; International Conference Hall Price List, January 2027 edition; International Exhibition Hall Terms of Use, applied from October 1, 2023)
ops.restaurants: There are 2 cafeterias in the Central Mall of the International Exhibition Hall: WORLD KITCHENS! (in front of Exhibition Hall 6, 390 seats) and ROYAL KITCHENS! (in front of Exhibition Hall 1, 300 seats). Both accept private parties and bento box catering (business days depend on the event schedule). The convenience stores are New Yamazaki Daily Store Makuhari Messe (Central Entrance), Daily Yamazaki Makuhari Messe II (in front of Exhibition Hall 9) and Daily Yamazaki Makuhari Messe III (in front of Exhibition Hall 1). Makuhari Messe handles the "Makuhari Messe Meal Ticket," which can be used at the main restaurants in the hotels and office buildings in Makuhari New City, including Makuhari Messe. (Source: Official website, Restaurants and Convenience Stores, and Q&A, retrieved November 2026)
